title: Builld
subtitle: Frontend studio for polished digital products
description: A product studio website and frontend system for presenting how Builld helps startups and businesses move from idea to a credible digital launch. The experience combines clear positioning, service storytelling, and a reusable visual language.
problem: A product studio needs to communicate speed and quality at the same time. The website had to make the offer understandable quickly, show confidence through the interface, and give different types of clients a clear next step.
role: Focused on the frontend implementation: responsive page composition, reusable interface sections, visual hierarchy, motion details, and the presentation of Builld's services and product capability.
approach: Used React and Next.js to build a modular frontend with reusable sections, consistent spacing and typography, responsive layouts, and a focused conversion path. The system balances template efficiency with enough flexibility for each service and case-study surface to feel distinctive.
hardestDecision: Balancing speed with quality. The studio model demands fast delivery, but each project needs enough customization to feel unique. Solved this by building a strong internal component library that handles the 80% case, leaving customization budget for the 20% that makes each project distinctive.
outcome: Live at builld.tech as a focused frontend experience for communicating Builld's product design and web delivery offer.
whatIdChange: Would add an AI-assisted scoping tool for faster project estimation, build a client portal for real-time project tracking, and expand the template library for common startup use cases.
